evidence.text: Built the labelled training set for the card-not-present fraud model at Saltire Card Services, joining confirmed fraud reports and chargeback reason codes to transactions with a 90-day label delay.
Retrained the gradient-boosted fraud model on 2022 data and recalibrated its alert thresholds with the fraud strategy managers over a series of threshold workshops.

HR verification note: the model performance memo the candidate mentioned at interview was obtained directly from Saltire Card Services' model risk office. At a fixed alert rate of 0.5%, it records card-not-present fraud value detected rising from 61% (January to March 2023) to 74% (July to September 2023), after the retrained model went into use in May 2023.
